# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
print("Number of loyal, completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))

# Check revenue dtype and sample values
print("Revenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(5).values)"}
